title: Ten MU, twenty MI identity and carrier plan
summary: A/B/C/D/E/I/J/K identities retain routes 1–16; append F routes 17–18 and H routes 19–20. Each MI reaches its own MU on Layer 2.
invariants: Do not reorder accepted identities or regenerate older authorities when adding a MU.
MI ↔ owning MU uses XTP L2 EtherType 0x817D; non-Google MU↔MU uses raw IPv4 protocol 36; MU routes touching Google use XTP over UDP 62801.
Target ten-MU directed carrier matrix: 56 native L3, 34 UDP L4, plus 20 local L2 MI memberships.
Operator SSH is not an MI application-dispatch channel.
All route lookup keys are symbolic GRID.MN.<MI>, not MAC literals; route resolution selects commissioned MAC and egress.

provenance.claim: Symbolic route lookup and authenticated XTP submitter
